market: Czech Republic monthly gross salary, technology roles, 2026
_doc: Role × seniority anchor bands fed into the Gemini prompt as deterministic findings. Numbers are CZK monthly gross. Sources: Platy.cz IT category 2026, Kitalent Prague ICT analysis 2025–2026, expats.cz salary surveys, Glassdoor + Levels.fyi cross-checks. The deterministic layer also computes a multiplier on top via data/taxonomy.json::company_adjustments. See README sources section.
